what: The id formats of the synthesised birthday layer (DESIGN §10.3): one read-only calendar per contact list, one all-day event per contact and year. host_core::birthdays mints them; both frontends recognise a birthday calendar or event by their prefixes where only an id is at hand.
why: The frontends gate on these: the calendar list hides "Manage" for a synthetic calendar, the event editors open a read-only summary for a synthetic event, and the mobile reminder overview reopens one by title. A prefix spelt differently on one side would let a contact-derived event open a form whose save can only fail — silently, on one surface.
